newsitem.title: USA: Renal Care files for 3 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Renal Care files for 3 million shares.

text.p: Renal Care Group Inc said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue up to three million common shares.
Of the amount, 1.5 million is being offered by the company and 1.5 million by selling shareholders, the filing said.

The underwriters have been offered an over-allotment option of up to 450,000 additional common shares. The offering is being made through Equitable Securities Corp, Hambrecht and Quist, Morgan Keegan & Co Inc and Needham & Co Inc.
After the offering the company will have 14,125,954 common shares outstanding, the filing said.
Proceeds will be used for general corporate, which may include potential future acquisitions.
On September 30, the company completed a merger with RenalWest L.C., which was accounted for as a pooling of interests, the filing said.
Renal Care closed on October 9 at $36.25 per share on Nasdaq.
